verdict.rationale: Mixpanel ships Warehouse Connectors to sync warehouse tables (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, Postgres) into Mixpanel for import, and a Raw Event Export API/JSONL for high-volume export of events out, which developers can pipe into a warehouse. However, this is one-way import plus a generic export API rather than a native, continuous bidirectional sync or in-product SQL query over warehouse tables. Missing for 10: evidence of querying warehouse tables directly in-product (reverse ETL/live query) and of a managed continuous export-to-warehouse connector (vs. manual API polling).
